generic.refused: The server refused this. Reload the page and try again.
generic.failed: Something went wrong on the server. Try again in a moment.
generic.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
log-in: Your login ended. Log in again.
wrong-origin: easi.run is set up for {origin}, not this address. Open it there, then try again.
too-many-attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
login-again: That took too long. Enter your password again.
wrong-password: That is not your current password.
bad-request: The server could not read this request. Reload the page and try again.
server-failed: Something went wrong on the server. Try again in a moment.
server-unsaved: This could not be saved on the server. Try again.
passkey-needs-domain: Passkeys need easi.run opened at a name such as localhost, not at an IP address.
too-many-passkeys: You can have up to {max} passkeys. Remove one first.
passkey-expired: That took too long. Add the passkey again.
passkey-refused: This passkey could not be added. Try again, or use another one.
no-passkey: That passkey is no longer here.
app-needs-password: Enter your current password to replace the authenticator app.
wrong-code: That is not the code the app shows. Try the next one.
app-off: The authenticator app is already off.
second-step-off: Turn on a second step first.
demo-full: Every demo browser is in use right now.
demo-yours: A demo is already open from your address.
demo-often: Too many demos from your address. Try again later.
demo-switching: A switch is already on its way.
demo-switch-needs-turn: Take control of the screen to switch demos.
demo-not-opened: The demo has not opened. Try again.
demo-open-elsewhere: This demo is already open in another tab.
not-in-demo: This is not available in the demo.
no-session: This session is no longer running.
session-failed: This session failed. Close it, then start a new one.
control-held: Someone else has control of this session.
no-viewer: This window is no longer connected to the session. Reload the page.
control-not-held: This window does not have control.
person-in-control: A person has control of this session. Try again once they give it back.
agent-busy: This session’s agent is busy. Try again in a moment.
too-many-sessions: Too many sessions are running. Stop one first.
bad-url: Use a web address that starts with http:// or https://, up to {max} bytes long.
bad-size: The screen size for this session is not supported.
display-not-started: The session’s screen did not start. Try again.
stop-failed: Stopping this session failed. Try again.
no-download: This download is no longer here.
downloads-busy: Too many downloads at once. Try again when one ends.
control-moved: Control moved to another window, so the download ended.
download-gone: This download is no longer available.
token-name: Give it a name of 1 to {max} characters.
too-many-tokens: You can have up to {max} tokens. Revoke one first.
no-token: This token is no longer here.
token-revoke-unsaved: The token no longer works, but the server could not save that yet. It keeps trying; until then, a restart would let the token work again.
token-sessions-not-stopped: The token is revoked, but some of its sessions could not be stopped. Stop them in Sessions.
no-saved-session: This saved session is no longer here.
saved-locked: Saved sessions are locked. Unlock them with your password first.
saved-other-password: This saved session was made under another password and cannot be opened. Delete it and make a new one.
saved-running: This saved session is already running. Stop it first, or resume another.
saved-name: Give it a name of 1 to {max} characters, different from the others.
too-many-saved: You can have up to {max} saved sessions. Delete one first.
saved-data-missing: This saved session’s data is missing from the server. Restore it, or delete the saved session.
saved-archive-broken: This saved session’s data was changed or cut, so it cannot be opened.
saved-not-restored: This saved session could not be opened. Try again.
save-too-large: What this session keeps is larger than {max} MiB, so it was not saved. The saved session keeps its last save.
save-failed: The last save failed. The saved session keeps the save before it.
no-proxy: This proxy is no longer here.
proxy-name: Use 1 to {max} lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
proxy-url: That proxy URL is not valid. It looks like http://user:password@host:port.
proxy-timezone: That time zone is not one the browser knows.
too-many-proxies: You can have up to {max} proxies. Delete one first.
proxy-in-use: Sessions use this proxy. Stop them first.
proxy-checks-busy: Busy, try again in a moment
proxy-check-unavailable: The proxy could not be checked. Try again.
proxy-check-auth: The proxy wants a valid user name and password
proxy-check-protocol: The proxy did not answer as a proxy
proxy-check-unexpected: The proxy answered, but not as expected
